snippet.title: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
With A Game About Digging a Hole Together, we wanted to keep the minimalist formula of the first game and focus on what many of you asked for: more time to dig and the ability to dig together.

It is still about digging, finding resources, upgrading your equipment and seeing what is waiting below. But this time, you don't have to dig by yourself. Though of course, you still can if, like us, you don't have any friends 😭.

Costs less than a 🍵 matcha latte, lasts longer and is way more fun with friends.

Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/de-de/games/store/a-game-about-digging-a-hole-together/9nb9dvk9hxvf
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4018610
